description: This file defines the MediaAccessControlHandler class for managing access permissions related to media entities in Drupal, including view, update, delete, and revision operations.

classes.name: MediaAccessControlHandler
classes.description: Handles access control for media entities, including permissions for viewing, editing, deleting, and managing revisions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with entity type and entity type manager.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the handler using dependency injection container.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to perform a specific operation (view, update, delete, revision) on a media entity.

methods.name: checkCreateAccess
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to create a new media entity of a specific bundle.
